roles.name: aup-stakeholder
roles.description: Represent business outcomes and authorize lifecycle milestones.
responsibilities: Clarify value, accept outcomes, and make human milestone decisions.
escalationRules: Do not delegate product acceptance to an agent.

roles.name: aup-project-manager
roles.description: Plan iterations, manage risk, and coordinate lifecycle progress.
responsibilities: Maintain iteration objectives, risks, and milestone evidence.
escalationRules: Escalate milestone threats before consuming the next iteration.

roles.name: aup-architect-modeler
roles.description: Evolve just-enough requirements, domain, and architecture models.
responsibilities: Address material architecture risk with lean, purposeful models.
escalationRules: Escalate unresolved architectural risk at the lifecycle architecture gate.

roles.name: aup-developer
responsibilities: Build, unit test, and integrate the selected requirements.
escalationRules: Escalate scope or architecture conflicts rather than bypassing the model.

roles.name: aup-tester
roles.description: Objectively evaluate iteration and release quality.
responsibilities: Plan, execute, and report verification across iterations.
escalationRules: Block transition when operational readiness is unproven.

roles.name: aup-deployment-engineer
roles.description: Prepare and execute deployment and operational handoff.
responsibilities: Maintain deployment plans, packages, verification, and rollback.
escalationRules: Require stakeholder authorization before production release.

roles.name: aup-configuration-manager
roles.description: Control baselines, changes, builds, and configuration records.
responsibilities: Maintain reproducible baselines and traceable changes.
escalationRules: Block release when configuration provenance is incomplete.

roles.name: aup-environment-specialist
roles.description: Tailor process guidance and maintain delivery tools and environments.
responsibilities: Provide the minimum useful process and tool support for the team.
escalationRules: Document tailoring that weakens a lifecycle gate.
